status: Internal Test only. v0.3.27 adds TLE-style remote update controls to the existing Messenger extension fold. Real ST/TT runtime verification is required before Stable promotion.
notes: Keeps the current Bootstrap 1.0.2 and headless Loader 0.1.3. Adds a user-facing update manager inside the existing Messenger extension fold: Stable/Test channel selection, manual check/install, rollback, automatic-update toggle, and live Loader/Bootstrap status. Does not add another floating launcher or alter the Stable manifest or existing data keys. Includes a loader-busy guard and copies Loader channel/version/status into the existing extension diagnostic report.
